assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for a 2D side-view action platformer.
REFERENCE: attached image is the identity/style anchor ONLY. Preserve this same young man: tousled dark brown hair, big rectangular black glasses, short beard, black sweatshirt/trousers/sneakers. Proportions and face consistent in every frame.
Create a NEW sheet with EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS AND FOUR ROWS, 16 equally sized square cells, one complete full-body character per cell. All face RIGHT. Transparent background, no checkerboard, no grid, no labels, no ground/shadows/environment. Crisp genuine low-resolution pixel clusters, limited charcoal cloth/warm skin/cool steel palette, no smooth painting.
Body registration: same scale and feet baseline in every cell; hips near x=38% of each cell, feet at y=88%, standing head near y=29%. Leave substantial air above and to the right for the pipe. Every weapon and foot fully contained in its cell. Weapon: ONE ordinary weathered steel pipe with dark wrapped grip; modest diameter, no blade, no hammer, no glowing giant sword. Pipe length about torso+head height.
Each ROW is four chronological keyframes, with real changes to knees, torso twist and arms; weapon gripped firmly in BOTH hands during attacks:
ROW 1: quick forward pipe strike. 1 compact anticipation at right shoulder; 2 extended forward strike at enemy chest height; 3 downward-forward contact near enemy waist, body leaning into right front leg; 4 retract to front guard.
ROW 2: second quick FORWARD strike, NOT a reverse/backward swing. 1 draw pipe in near chest with knees loaded; 2 two-handed thrust far to the RIGHT at waist height; 3 extended low forward follow-through, firm front foot; 4 recover facing RIGHT.
ROW 3: heavier third finisher. 1 pipe raised overhead in both hands, bent knees; 2 forceful downward strike IN FRONT to the RIGHT; 3 low forward contact near ground with compressed body; 4 lift slightly into recovery.
ROW 4: forward kick. 1 shift weight onto back leg; 2 knee lifted; 3 right boot fully extended forward at enemy waist height, torso leaning back; 4 leg retracting to ground.
No facing left, no attack behind the character, no duplicated static poses, no multiple exposure limbs, no detached weapon. This is a carefully registered game animation sheet, not a character concept poster. Keep reference face/outfit.
assets.backgroundEdit: Edit ONLY the background of this sprite sheet. Replace the entire white/light grey checkerboard with perfectly uniform solid RGB(255,0,255) magenta for a game colour-key importer. Preserve every pixel-art character, pipe, boot, face, pose, size, placement, all sixteen frames, and the whole sheet dimensions. Do not redraw the subjects. No checkerboard, no transparency simulation, no gradients, no shadows, no extra marks.
